comparison.objective: Seat and latch a switch line card using paired ejector levers.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated lever closure, connector-force control, and avoidance of card cocking.
comparison.success_condition: Both card ends within 1 mm of home, both levers within 3°, hands clear, held 1 s; excessive end-gap mismatch invalidates.
comparison.reason: Tests synchronized leverage and connector seating, not selective many-body separation through apertures.
